freeze_condition: G0 instrument-validity verdict; on freeze copy verbatim to experiments/cache-tax-bench/PREREGISTRATION.md and never edit after first run
hypothesis: H1 partitioning law: billable (uncached) prompt tokens for a fixed token subsequence equal tokens beyond the last 64-aligned reusable boundary, so state-render (invariant prefix + appended delta) costs a per-turn delta flat in n while full re-render grows linearly in n

causal_isolation_argument.same_subsequence: both arms transmit P + delta_1..delta_n in the same order; asserted per pair by tokenising both bodies (control C5), not assumed
causal_isolation_argument.same_envelope: temperature 0, thinking off, same max_tokens, tools absent in Arm A (build_request_body order fixed at src/resextract/llm/occamy.py:456-495)
causal_isolation_argument.between_run_isolation: prefix cache flushed before every (arm, depth) cell so depth-n measurement is not contaminated by the other arm
causal_isolation_argument.only_differing_respect: longest reusable prefix is P (arm a) versus P + delta_1..delta_{n-1} (arm b)
causal_isolation_argument.explicit_limit: arms differ in cache state, so a TTFT difference is confounded and is reported only as a magnitude/sanity check, never as mechanism

arm_a_metrics.BM: sum(u_i)/sum(p_i) token-weighted, pooled over n requests of the cell
arm_a_metrics.BM_tail: u_n / p_n at the final turn
arm_a_metrics.W: sum(c_i mod 64) and sum(u_i mod 64) separately
arm_a_metrics.R: u_n arm(a) / u_n arm(b) at same n; <1 favours state rendering
arm_a_metrics.TTFT: send to first streamed byte, reported only where the arms' p_n differ by < 5%
arm_a_metrics.throughput_sanity: completion tokens / generation wall time; flag, do not report, a collapsing cell
arm_a_metrics.aggregation: mean [min, max] over 3 reps plus pooled; with 3 reps no CI is claimed

arm_b_statistics: band distribution (count and token-weighted share per prompt_token_band)
request-weighted pooled rate AND median per-session rate, both required
arm_b_disclaimer: These are descriptive statistics from recorded production traffic. Turns are not randomised, renderer choice correlates with prompt length and with the task itself, and sessions are not independent. No causal claim is made from this table.

C3.recovery_check: re-issue original must return full cached

C6.if_fails: measurement is not distinguishing renderings; re-read C1

predictions.name: tax law
predictions.statement: on a full repeat, billable u = L mod 64 exactly
predictions.kill: K1: >= 2 of 4 lengths miss L mod 64 by more than 32 tokens; observed relationship then reported as fitted, not derived

predictions.name: collapse law
predictions.statement: insertion before a cached boundary invalidates all after it; after the boundary only what follows
predictions.numeric_point: marker of k tokens at offset o into cached L gives cached ~ 64*floor((o-1)/64); o > L gives ~L
predictions.kill: K2: a post-prompt insertion ever drops cached below L-32 refutes the prefix-only instrument model
predictions.pre_registered_tension: prior probe recorded 0/813 cached for a marker at char 2000 of an 807-token prompt (a ~40-token offset), which P2 as stated would not predict; C3 resolves this and if it reproduces total collapse P2 is replaced by the total-collapse law as a DATED ADDENDUM, original text kept

predictions.name: depth law
predictions.statement: per-turn billable flat in n for state renderer, ~linear for full re-render
predictions.numeric_point: arm(a) BM_tail spread <= 64 tokens across all nine depths; arm(b) BM(cell) >= 5x arm(a) BM(cell) at n=190
predictions.kill: K3: arm(a) fitted growth over n=8..190 exceeding 32 tokens per 10 turns kills the flat half; arm(b) failing to grow monotonically kills the linear half
